fix: Replace <div onClick> with a native <button> element, or add role="button" with tabIndex and keyboard handlers.
Never use "overflow: hidden" or "overflow-x: hidden" on html or body. Use "overflow-x: clip" instead.
Avoid "width: 100vw" as it causes horizontal scrollbars on desktop with scrollbar gutters. Use "width: 100%" instead.
Replace literal color with a CSS variable token defined in :root (e.g. var(--color-brand-500)).
Never transition "all". Specify explicit properties (e.g. "transition: transform 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out").
Never set "outline: none" or "outline: 0" without pairing it with an immediate, visible :focus-visible ring.
File defines CSS animation or @keyframes without @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) override.
